zh.title: Sony PRS-700 加 Pico：借 SD 卡更新电子书内容
zh.summary: 作者计划让 Pico 改写 SD 卡上的 EPUB/PDF，使旧 Sony PRS-700 成为文本显示器；目前仍在研究和备料。
zh.gap: 没有完成接线、代码、刷新演示或稳定性结果，作者也未确认阅读器是否逐页读取 SD 卡。
zh.next_check: 等待真实文件更新实验、供电方案和可复现代码，再判断是否能从研究升级为原型。
zh.safety: 不要把计划当成可用教程；拆电池和并联供电前先确认电压、充电与保护。
zh.usable: 现在只能作为旧阅读器文件注入思路，不能按此页面完成改造。
works_for: Sony PRS-700 这一作者研究对象
愿意分析 SD 卡读取行为的开发者
not_for: 需要即用信息屏的普通用户
把任意阅读器视为相同存储行为
zh.value: 清楚保存了一条避开屏幕高压驱动的替代思路，也明确暴露关键未知。
zh.follow: 想做协议研究可以继续；想要可靠显示应先选已有工作路线。
zh.resource_note: 页面说明目标、PRS-700、SD 卡假设、电池计划及仍未验证的关键问题。

en.title: Sony PRS-700 with Pico: update reader content through SD storage
en.summary: The author plans to let a Pico rewrite EPUB/PDF files on an SD card so an old Sony PRS-700 can display changing text; the work remains at research and parts-gathering stage.
en.gap: There is no completed wiring, code, refresh demonstration or stability result, and page-by-page SD reads are still an assumption.
en.next_check: Wait for a real file-update experiment, power design and reproducible code before treating it as a prototype.
en.safety: Do not treat the plan as a working guide; verify voltage, charging and protection before battery or shared-power work.
en.usable: It is currently an idea for file injection on an older reader, not a buildable conversion.
works_for: The author's Sony PRS-700 research target
Developers willing to characterize SD-card behavior
not_for: Users needing a ready information display
Assuming all readers access removable storage identically
en.value: Preserves a route that may avoid direct high-voltage panel driving while exposing the unresolved assumptions.
en.follow: Continue for protocol research; choose a demonstrated route for a dependable display.
en.resource_note: Describes the goal, PRS-700, SD-card hypothesis, battery plan and unresolved questions.

zh.title: Trash Drone Router：用旧路由器和废件做联网无人机
zh.summary: 作者把旧路由器、PIC、Wii 传感器、IP 摄像头和电机组合成低成本联网无人机平台，并公开论文、博客与飞控代码入口。
zh.gap: 资料跨多个旧链接，项目已多年未更新；飞行安全、无线法规、当前代码和具体硬件版本未统一核对。
zh.next_check: 保存仍可访问的代码和论文，确认一套实际机体、控制链与失控保护。
zh.safety: 旋翼、电池和无线发射都有现实风险；没有失控保护和合法频段时不应飞行。
zh.usable: 可研究废旧路由器作为机载联网节点的系统思路，不适合作为当前即用无人机套件。
works_for: 旧 OpenWrt 类路由器与可替换传感器的实验
研究低成本空中网络的平台设计
not_for: 直接复制为可安全飞行的成品
未经法规和失效测试的户外飞行
zh.value: 把多类废件如何组成完整系统记录在一起，可用于架构与失败模式研究。
zh.follow: 做历史技术研究可继续；实际飞行应从当前受支持的飞控与安全链开始。
zh.resource_note: 包含硬件复用目标、组件、论文、博客和飞控源码入口。

en.title: Trash Drone Router: networked aircraft from routers and salvaged parts
en.summary: The author combines old routers, PICs, Wii sensors, IP cameras and motors into a low-cost connected drone platform, with paper, blog and flight-controller links.
en.gap: Material is spread across aging links and has not been updated for years; flight safety, radio rules, current code and exact hardware versions are not reconciled.
en.next_check: Archive accessible code and papers, then identify one actual airframe, control path and failsafe design.
en.safety: Propellers, batteries and radio transmission create real hazards; do not fly without failsafes and legal frequencies.
en.usable: Useful for studying a salvaged router as an airborne network node, not as a current ready-to-fly kit.
works_for: Experiments with older OpenWrt-class routers and replaceable sensors
Studying low-cost airborne-network architecture
not_for: Copying directly into a safe finished aircraft
Outdoor flight without regulatory and failure testing
en.value: Records how several waste-device classes can form one system and supports architecture and failure analysis.
en.follow: Continue for historical system research; use currently supported flight-control safety paths for real flight.
en.resource_note: Links the reuse goal, components, paper, blog and flight-controller source.

zh.title: Display Server：让旧显示器专门显示文档和图片
zh.summary: 项目用树莓派驱动闲置显示器，通过 SCP、共享目录、网页或 WebSocket 接收静态文档与艺术图片。
zh.gap: 页面仍写着即将发布但多年未更新；安装包、维护状态和无人值守恢复未核验。
zh.next_check: 确认源码、安装步骤、开机恢复和当前浏览器/图像依赖。
zh.safety: 不要拆 CRT 或老显示器电源；优先使用完整显示器的标准视频输入。
zh.usable: 架构和传输方式描述清楚，可作为工作台资料屏原型，但发布完成度不明。
works_for: 带标准视频输入的闲置 LCD 显示器
树莓派或其他能驱动显示器的小主机
not_for: 没有控制板的裸 LCD 面板
要求维护完善的一键部署
zh.value: 把显示器从普通副屏变成无鼠标干扰的专用资料屏。
zh.follow: 能自行维护 Linux 启动和传输脚本时值得试；否则使用成熟数字标牌软件。
zh.resource_note: 说明静态文档、艺术图片、四种传输方式和 MIT 许可主张。

en.title: Display Server: dedicate older monitors to documents and art
en.summary: The project uses a Raspberry Pi with spare monitors and accepts static documents or art through SCP, shared folders, a web page or WebSocket.
en.gap: The page still says a release is coming and has been quiet for years; install artifacts, maintenance and unattended recovery are unverified.
en.next_check: Confirm source, setup steps, boot recovery and current browser/image dependencies.
en.safety: Do not open CRTs or old monitor power supplies; prefer complete displays with standard video inputs.
en.usable: The architecture and transfer methods are clear enough for a workbench prototype, while release completeness is unclear.
works_for: Spare LCD monitors with standard video input
A Raspberry Pi or similar display-capable host
not_for: Bare LCD panels without controllers
Users needing a maintained one-click deployment
en.value: Turns a general monitor into a dedicated reference display without pointer or window-management friction.
en.follow: Worth trying if you can maintain Linux boot and transfer scripts; otherwise use maintained signage software.
en.resource_note: Describes static documents, art display, four transfer methods and an MIT-license claim.

zh.title: 原版 iPad 换装 Raspberry Pi CM4 主板
zh.summary: 作者为 2010 年 iPad 设计 CM4 替换主板，目标复用外壳、电池、触摸、LCD、天线、扬声器和按键，并记录可启动系统。
zh.gap: 自制 PCB、屏幕与电池管理复杂，项目仍在推进；完整物料、长期电池安全和全部外设支持未形成普通用户套件。
zh.next_check: 核对最新 PCB 修订、制造文件、LCD/触摸驱动、充放电保护和系统镜像。
zh.safety: 老化锂电池和定制电源板必须单独检查；不能只因 CM4 能启动就认为充电安全。
zh.usable: 高级开发者可复用大部分原机结构做 Linux/Android 平板，普通用户仍缺少成熟套件。
works_for: 2010 年第一代 iPad 的作者硬件范围
有细间距焊接和 PCB 调试能力的开发者
not_for: 其他 iPad 代际直接套用
只想通过软件更新恢复现代应用
zh.value: 少见地尝试保留原机大量部件，而不是只把外壳当盒子。
zh.follow: 能审板、处理电池并接受高成本原型时继续；普通用户等待稳定硬件版本。
zh.resource_note: 记录目标部件、替换主板、CM4 启动、PCB 和外设调试进展。

en.title: Replace an original iPad logic board with Raspberry Pi CM4
en.summary: The author designs a CM4 replacement board for a 2010 iPad to reuse the enclosure, battery, touch, LCD, antennas, speaker and buttons, with a reported booting system.
en.gap: Custom PCB, display and battery management remain complex; a complete BOM, long-term battery safety and all peripherals are not packaged for ordinary users.
en.next_check: Review the latest PCB revision, manufacturing files, LCD/touch drivers, charge protection and system image.
en.safety: The aged lithium battery and custom power board need separate validation; a booting CM4 does not prove safe charging.
en.usable: Advanced builders may reuse much of the original structure for Linux/Android, while no mature consumer kit exists.
works_for: The author's 2010 first-generation iPad scope
Developers capable of fine-pitch soldering and PCB debug
not_for: Applying directly to other iPad generations
Users seeking a software-only route to modern apps
en.value: Unusually aims to retain many original components instead of using only the enclosure.
en.follow: Continue if board review, battery work and prototype cost are acceptable; others should wait for stable hardware.
en.resource_note: Documents retained parts, replacement board, CM4 boot, PCB and peripheral progress.

zh.title: DLT One：可更换模块的 Linux 平板
zh.summary: 项目提出开放的机械与电气模块标准，让平板的主板、屏幕、电池和外设可升级并跨机型复用。
zh.gap: 它主要是新硬件平台而非现成旧平板转换套件；多个 PCB 修订和机械兼容仍在迭代。
zh.next_check: 确认最新可制造文件、已装配版本、模块兼容表与实际可复用旧部件。
zh.safety: 电池管理和不同模块的电压/连接器不能凭尺寸相近直接互换。
zh.usable: 可作为可修复平板设计参考，尚不能让任意旧平板直接模块化。
works_for: 开发开放平板或工业终端的人
研究跨代复用屏幕、电池和外设接口
not_for: 直接升级现有 iPad 或 Android 平板
没有 PCB 和结构设计能力的快速改造
zh.value: 提供减少整机报废的模块化设计思路和迭代记录。
zh.follow: 做硬件平台研究值得继续；处理一台现有旧平板时选择对应机型项目。
zh.resource_note: 说明模块标准、主板/外设复用目标、BOM 与 PCB 修订兼容问题。

en.title: DLT One: a modular Linux tablet platform
en.summary: The project proposes open mechanical and electrical module standards so tablet boards, displays, batteries and peripherals can be upgraded and reused across form factors.
en.gap: It is primarily a new hardware platform rather than a conversion kit for an existing tablet, and PCB/mechanical compatibility is still iterative.
en.next_check: Confirm current manufacturable files, assembled revisions, module matrix and which salvaged parts are actually reusable.
en.safety: Battery management, voltage and connectors cannot be interchanged merely because modules fit mechanically.
en.usable: Useful as a repairable-tablet design reference, but it cannot modularize an arbitrary old tablet.
works_for: People developing open tablets or industrial terminals
Research into cross-generation display, battery and peripheral reuse
not_for: Direct upgrades of existing iPads or Android tablets
Quick builds without PCB and mechanical-design capability
en.value: Provides a modular design approach and iteration record aimed at preventing complete-device disposal.
en.follow: Continue for platform research; use a model-specific project for one existing tablet.
en.resource_note: Explains module standards, reuse goals, BOM and PCB-revision compatibility issues.

zh.title: The Disassembler：把旧 3D 打印机改成自动拆焊平台
zh.summary: 团队在家用 3D 打印机运动机构上安装烙铁和相机，用机器视觉寻找焊点并尝试自动拆取元件。
zh.gap: 仍是实验阶段，主要面向手工焊接板；识别准确率、温控、烟雾和工业电子产品适用性未完成。
zh.next_check: 核对可运行代码、相机标定、温度控制、成功拆取率和元件损伤数据。
zh.safety: 热烙铁、烟雾、运动机构和带电电容需要隔离、防护与排烟。
zh.usable: 可研究如何把废旧打印机变成拆焊实验平台，不能视为自动回收机。
works_for: 结构仍能运动的 FDM 3D 打印机
已断电、已放电的简单手工焊接板实验
not_for: 复杂多层量产板的自动拆解
无人看护的高温运行
zh.value: 把元件再利用、视觉识别和旧运动平台连接成可观察的研究方向。
zh.follow: 有实验室安全条件和算法开发能力时继续；只需偶尔拆件时手工工具更合适。
zh.resource_note: 描述拆螺丝器、拆焊器、相机识别和基于 3D 打印机运动平台的阶段目标。

en.title: The Disassembler: convert an old 3D printer into automated desoldering
en.summary: The team mounts a soldering iron and camera on a home 3D-printer motion system, using vision to find joints and attempt automated component removal.
en.gap: It remains experimental and targets hand-soldered boards; recognition accuracy, temperature control, fumes and mass-produced electronics are unresolved.
en.next_check: Verify runnable code, camera calibration, temperature control, removal success and component-damage measurements.
en.safety: Hot tools, fumes, motion and charged capacitors require isolation, guarding and extraction.
en.usable: A research platform for turning an old printer into a desoldering experiment, not an automatic recycling machine.
works_for: FDM printers with functioning motion systems
Powered-off and discharged simple hand-soldered boards
not_for: Automatic processing of complex multilayer production boards
Unattended high-temperature operation
en.value: Connects component reuse, vision and a salvaged motion platform in an observable research path.
en.follow: Continue with lab safety and algorithm skills; use hand tools for occasional component recovery.
en.resource_note: Describes the de-screwer, desolderer, camera recognition and 3D-printer motion platform.

zh.title: Trash Printer V3：复用旧 3D 打印机零件制造再生塑料打印机
zh.summary: 项目尝试用本地废塑料和从旧 3D 打印机回收的运动件，构建易制造的塑料再利用打印系统。
zh.gap: 需要自行制造机械结构和处理塑料；成品质量、材料污染、挤出稳定性和完整成本未由 KitAgain 核验。
zh.next_check: 核对最新图纸、BOM、进料流程、温度范围和一套完整打印验收。
zh.safety: 塑料加热、粉尘、切削和高功率加热器需要通风、温控和防火保护。
zh.usable: 适合有制作空间的人研究旧打印机零件和废塑料再利用，不是桌面即插即用设备。
works_for: 可回收步进电机、导轨等部件的旧 3D 打印机
能分类清洁塑料并加工框架的工作室
not_for: 混合或来源不明塑料直接熔融
家庭无人看护运行
zh.value: 同时处理旧机器部件和废塑料，且作者强调低工具门槛。
zh.follow: 有通风、防火和机械制造能力时研究；普通打印需求优先修复现有打印机。
zh.resource_note: 说明低成本目标、旧打印机零件来源、加工工具和塑料循环路线。

en.title: Trash Printer V3: build a recycled-plastic printer from older printer parts
en.summary: The project combines local waste plastic with motion parts salvaged from older 3D printers to create an accessible recycling/printing machine.
en.gap: It requires machine fabrication and plastic processing; output quality, contamination, extrusion stability and full cost are not verified by KitAgain.
en.next_check: Review current drawings, BOM, feedstock process, temperature range and one complete-print acceptance record.
en.safety: Plastic heating, dust, cutting and high-power heaters require ventilation, temperature protection and fire controls.
en.usable: Suitable for equipped makerspaces studying old-printer parts and waste plastic, not a plug-in desktop appliance.
works_for: Older printers yielding stepper motors, rails and related parts
Workshops able to clean plastic and fabricate a frame
not_for: Melting mixed or unknown plastics
Unattended home operation
en.value: Addresses both machine-part reuse and plastic waste with an emphasis on accessible tooling.
en.follow: Research with ventilation, fire protection and fabrication capability; repair an existing printer first for ordinary printing needs.
en.resource_note: Describes the low-cost goal, salvaged printer parts, tools and plastic-recycling route.

zh.title: 旧功能机来电遥控开关
zh.summary: 作者从旧 Nokia 类手机振动电机焊点读取来电/短信触发，再由 Arduino 和继电器切换外部负载。
zh.gap: 只读到作者完成记录；白名单、防误触、2G/3G 退网、继电器隔离和长期可靠性未系统验证。
zh.next_check: 先核对当地蜂窝网络、呼叫白名单、低压模拟负载和误触测试。
zh.safety: 不能直接用随意继电器控制水泵或市电；垃圾短信和误拨也可能触发。
zh.usable: 在仍有兼容蜂窝网络时可做低压远程触发实验。
works_for: 带振动电机且仍可接入当地网络的旧功能机
低压、可安全失败的测试负载
not_for: 当地已关闭对应蜂窝制式
未经电气隔离的水泵和市电设备
zh.value: 展示无需数据网络也能复用旧手机通信链路。
zh.follow: 只在低压测试和严格白名单下继续；关键控制使用专用工业方案。
zh.resource_note: 包含 Nokia 3310 拆机、振动焊点、Arduino、继电器、代码和误触讨论。

en.title: Use an old feature phone as a call-triggered remote switch
en.summary: The author reads call/SMS activity from an old Nokia-class phone's vibration-motor pads, then lets an Arduino and relay switch an external load.
en.gap: Only the author build is reviewed; allowlisting, false triggers, 2G/3G shutdown, relay isolation and long-term reliability remain unresolved.
en.next_check: First verify local cellular service, call allowlisting, a low-voltage dummy load and false-trigger tests.
en.safety: Do not use an arbitrary relay directly for pumps or mains; spam messages and accidental calls can trigger it.
en.usable: A low-voltage remote-trigger experiment where a compatible cellular network still operates.
works_for: Feature phones with a vibration motor and local network service
Low-voltage loads that fail safely
not_for: Regions where the required cellular generation is shut down
Pumps or mains devices without engineered isolation
en.value: Demonstrates reuse of an old phone's communication path without mobile data.
en.follow: Continue only with low-voltage tests and strict allowlisting; use industrial controls for critical loads.
en.resource_note: Includes Nokia 3310 disassembly, vibration pads, Arduino, relay, code and false-trigger discussion.

zh.title: 旧笔记本改水冷 LED 投影与媒体中心
zh.summary: 作者把旧笔记本 LCD、主机和高功率 LED 组合成可更换笔记本核心的投影媒体中心，并记录第一版原型。
zh.gap: 项目约十年未更新；亮度、光学质量、散热、供电和高功率 LED 安全没有现代化验收。
zh.next_check: 核对面板尺寸、菲涅尔镜焦距、LED 驱动、实测温度和投影亮度。
zh.safety: 高功率 LED、强光、热量和可能的 CCFL 高压都需要遮光、温控与绝缘。
zh.usable: 适合光学和散热实验，不适合期望成品投影机体验的人。
works_for: LCD 和主板仍工作的旧笔记本
有光学、木工和散热设计能力的制作者
not_for: 屏幕本身破裂或严重漏光
需要安静、高亮、可靠家庭影院
zh.value: 展示整台旧笔记本而非单个零件的升级式复用结构。
zh.follow: 为学习光路可以继续；实际观影先比较修复或二手投影机。
zh.resource_note: 记录模块化换机思路、LED、菲涅尔镜、第一版原型和结构设计。

en.title: Turn an older laptop into a water-cooled LED projector and media center
en.summary: The author combines an older laptop LCD, host and high-power LED into a projector/media center designed around a swappable laptop core, with a first prototype documented.
en.gap: The project has been quiet for about a decade; brightness, optics, cooling, power and high-power LED safety lack current acceptance data.
en.next_check: Verify panel dimensions, Fresnel focal length, LED driver, measured temperatures and projected brightness.
en.safety: High-power LEDs, intense light, heat and possible CCFL high voltage require shielding, thermal control and insulation.
en.usable: Suitable for optics and cooling experiments, not for users expecting a finished projector experience.
works_for: Older laptops with working LCD and motherboard
Builders with optical, woodworking and thermal-design skills
not_for: Cracked or badly damaged panels
Quiet, bright and dependable home cinema
en.value: Shows a structure that reuses a whole laptop and allows later host replacement.
en.follow: Continue to learn projection optics; compare repair or a used projector for regular viewing.
en.resource_note: Documents the swappable-host idea, LED, Fresnel optics, first prototype and enclosure work.

zh.title: 老式打印机字库板改 LED 字符灯
zh.summary: 作者修改 DEC LA30 打印终端的字符发生器板，让计数器轮询字库并用七只 LED 显示点阵行数据。
zh.gap: 这是针对特定古董板卡的单例创作，没有通用接口或现代替代料路线。
zh.next_check: 保存板号、ROM 型号、改线图和工作视频，确认是否有可重复接线说明。
zh.safety: 只使用拆下并确认低压的逻辑板，不要给未知老设备整机上电。
zh.usable: 可作为数字逻辑和字库 ROM 教学作品，实用功能有限。
works_for: 相同 DEC LA30 字符板或同类可识别字库板
想观察旧 ROM 字符数据的学习实验
not_for: 通用打印机主板复用方法
需要实际打印或显示文字的成品
zh.value: 保留了一种从废板理解早期字符生成逻辑的做法。
zh.follow: 拥有同板且以学习为目标时跟进；普通废打印机先回收电机、导轨和电源。
zh.resource_note: 说明 MK2002 字库 ROM、计数逻辑、七只 LED 和改板动机。

en.title: Turn a vintage printer character board into LED art
en.summary: The author modifies a DEC LA30 terminal character-generator board so counters scan its ROM and seven LEDs expose dot-matrix row data.
en.gap: This is a one-off work for a particular vintage board, without a universal interface or modern replacement-parts route.
en.next_check: Preserve board number, ROM type, wiring modifications and working video, and check for repeatable instructions.
en.safety: Use only a removed logic board confirmed to be low voltage; do not power an unknown complete vintage machine.
en.usable: A digital-logic and font-ROM teaching artifact with limited practical function.
works_for: The same DEC LA30 character board or a similar identifiable ROM board
Learning experiments that expose old font data
not_for: A universal printer-mainboard reuse method
A finished device that prints or displays full text
en.value: Preserves a way to learn early character-generation logic from a discarded board.
en.follow: Follow if you own the same board and want to learn; for ordinary printers salvage motors, rails and supplies first.
en.resource_note: Explains the MK2002 font ROM, counters, seven LEDs and the board modification.

zh.title: 转盘电话变色彩选择灯
zh.summary: 作者在老 GTE 转盘电话中加入控制器和灯光，用拨号盘选择颜色，并保留听筒开关作为奇偶颜色控制。
zh.gap: 页面是作者作品展示，电路文件和针对不同转盘电话的接口范围有限。
zh.next_check: 核对所用控制器、拨号脉冲读取、供电和完整接线文件。
zh.safety: 先与电话线和铃流高压完全断开；不要连接仍在运营的公共电话网。
zh.usable: 可把机械拨号盘和外壳复用为交互灯光作品。
works_for: 机构完好的脉冲拨号电话
愿意保留原外观的低压互动装置
not_for: 需要继续普通电话通话
未与外线彻底隔离的设备
zh.value: 提供保留机械手感而赋予新交互的轻量示例。
zh.follow: 能识别拨号触点并安全隔离时继续；收藏价值高的完整电话先考虑无损方案。
zh.resource_note: 说明二十段色轮、摘挂机状态、五分钟变暗和成品演示。

en.title: Turn a rotary phone into a color-selection lamp
en.summary: The author adds control electronics and lighting to an old GTE rotary phone, using dial pulses for colors and the hook switch to select odd/even positions.
en.gap: The page is an author showcase with limited circuit files and no broad interface guide for other rotary phones.
en.next_check: Identify the controller, dial-pulse input, power design and complete wiring files.
en.safety: Disconnect completely from telephone lines and ringing voltage; never attach the modified unit to an active public network.
en.usable: Reuses the mechanical dial and enclosure as an interactive lighting object.
works_for: Pulse-dial phones with intact mechanics
Low-voltage interactive pieces retaining the original appearance
not_for: Continued ordinary telephone service
Devices not fully isolated from outside lines
en.value: A compact example of preserving tactile mechanics while giving the object a new interaction.
en.follow: Continue if dial contacts can be identified and isolated; prefer nondestructive work on collectible complete phones.
en.resource_note: Describes the twenty-part color wheel, hook state, five-minute dimming and finished demonstration.

zh.title: PhoneBlox：给旧 Android 手机增加模块化 USB 与电池背板
zh.summary: 项目为旧 Android 手机设计 3D 打印外壳、弹簧针 PCB、USB 2.0 和可换电池模块，已上传多份结构与 Gerber 文件。
zh.gap: 页面未建立多机型兼容矩阵；焊点、USB 引脚、电池保护、外壳适配和成品验收仍依赖作者机型。
zh.next_check: 确认作者实际手机型号、V1/V2 文件对应关系、USB OTG 与电池充放电保护。
zh.safety: 不要绕过原机电池保护；弹簧针错位或电源反接可能损坏手机和电池。
zh.usable: 可作为单一手机的模块背板原型，尚不是通用 Phonebloks 系统。
works_for: 能找到 USB 与电池焊点的作者式 Android 手机改造
会 PCB、FPC 和 3D 打印适配的开发者
not_for: 不拆机即可适配任意现代手机
把不同手机电池直接互换
zh.value: 提供了比概念图更接近制造的机械和 PCB 文件。
zh.follow: 有备用机且能审查电源设计时继续；主力机不要作为首个样品。
zh.resource_note: 包含 V1/V2 外壳、弹簧针 PCB、Gerber、零件和制作入口。

en.title: PhoneBlox: add modular USB and battery backplanes to an older Android phone
en.summary: The project designs printed housings, pogo-pin PCBs, USB 2.0 and swappable battery modules for an older Android phone, with several mechanical and Gerber files uploaded.
en.gap: There is no multi-model matrix; solder points, USB pins, battery protection, enclosure fit and finished acceptance remain device-specific.
en.next_check: Confirm the author's exact phone, V1/V2 file mapping, USB OTG and battery charge/discharge protection.
en.safety: Do not bypass original battery protection; pogo misalignment or reversed power can damage the phone and cell.
en.usable: A modular-back prototype for one phone, not a universal Phonebloks ecosystem.
works_for: Android-phone experiments with accessible USB and battery points
Developers able to adapt PCBs, FPCs and printed housings
not_for: Tool-free support for arbitrary modern phones
Directly interchanging batteries across phone models
en.value: Provides mechanical and PCB files closer to fabrication than a concept rendering.
en.follow: Continue with a spare phone and power-design review; do not use a primary phone as the first sample.
en.resource_note: Includes V1/V2 housings, pogo-pin PCBs, Gerbers, parts and build notes.

zh.title: Scraptop：把废笔记本变成手机扩展坞
zh.summary: 项目尝试保留旧笔记本屏幕、键盘和外壳，通过 USB OTG、DisplayLink、DVI/LVDS 转换让手机成为计算核心。
zh.gap: 关键 DisplayLink/LVDS 链复杂且缺少完成验收；平板排线和控制器并不标准化。
zh.next_check: 确认是否完成可用组合、具体屏幕型号、键盘矩阵控制器和视频链延迟。
zh.safety: 旧电池应移除或单独检测；CCFL 屏幕逆变器可能有高压。
zh.usable: 有价值的是整合路线和难点清单，当前不能当作通用转换板。
works_for: 外壳、键盘和 LCD 完整但主板报废的特定笔记本
愿意处理多级视频转换和 USB 控制的开发者
not_for: 希望单根线连接任意手机和任意笔记本
电池、LCD 或排线状态未知的机器
zh.value: 把旧笔记本最难复用的键盘和屏幕接口问题集中呈现。
zh.follow: 做接口研究可继续；实用扩展坞应先确认一个完整型号组合。
zh.resource_note: 说明 USB OTG、键盘控制、DisplayLink、DVI-LVDS 和供电设想及未完成难点。

en.title: Scraptop: turn a scrap laptop into a phone dock
en.summary: The project aims to retain an old laptop display, keyboard and enclosure while using USB OTG, DisplayLink and DVI/LVDS conversion around a phone as the compute core.
en.gap: The DisplayLink/LVDS chain is complex and lacks a completed acceptance result; laptop cables and controllers are not standardized.
en.next_check: Determine whether a usable combination was completed, including exact panel, keyboard controller and video-chain latency.
en.safety: Remove or separately evaluate old batteries; CCFL display inverters may produce high voltage.
en.usable: Its main value is the integration route and difficulty map, not a universal conversion board.
works_for: Specific laptops with intact enclosure, keyboard and LCD but failed mainboards
Developers willing to solve layered video and USB control
not_for: One-cable support for arbitrary phones and laptops
Machines with unknown battery, LCD or cable condition
en.value: Concentrates the hardest laptop-part reuse problems: keyboard and display interfaces.
en.follow: Continue for interface research; prove one exact combination before pursuing a practical dock.
en.resource_note: Describes USB OTG, keyboard control, DisplayLink, DVI/LVDS and power ideas plus incomplete blockers.

zh.title: 2006 年旧笔记本改数码相框
zh.summary: 作者拆出旧笔记本主板和屏幕，装入 12×18 英寸相框，用 MX Linux、Feh 和 VNC 自动播放照片。
zh.gap: 功能已完成，但作者记录约 13.5 kHz 啸叫且未解决；长期功耗、散热和墙面防火未测。
zh.next_check: 确认啸叫来源、自动重启、远程维护、温度和待机功耗。
zh.safety: 拆下老化电池，覆盖裸露电路并确保墙面安装散热与阻燃。
zh.usable: 可以实际播放照片并远程维护，但高频噪声可能使成品不可接受。
works_for: 主板和 LCD 仍工作的旧 x86 笔记本
能运行轻量 Linux 并从 USB 启动的机器
not_for: 对高频噪声敏感的房间
裸板无防护的长期墙装
zh.value: 完整记录了成功功能和一个没有美化的真实缺陷。
zh.follow: 先整机测试噪声、温度和自动恢复；通过后再拆装进框。
zh.resource_label: 作者完整制作与故障日志
zh.resource_note: 含 MX Linux、Feh、VNC、结构步骤和未解决的 13.5 kHz 啸叫。

en.title: Turn a 2006 laptop into a digital photo frame
en.summary: The author mounts an older laptop motherboard and display in a 12×18-inch frame, using MX Linux, Feh and VNC for an automatic slideshow.
en.gap: Function is complete, but the author records an unresolved roughly 13.5 kHz whine; long-term power, heat and wall-mount fire behavior are unmeasured.
en.next_check: Identify the whine source and verify automatic reboot, remote maintenance, temperature and idle power.
en.safety: Remove the aged battery, cover exposed electronics and provide cooling and flame-conscious wall mounting.
en.usable: It can display photos and be maintained remotely, but high-frequency noise may make the result unacceptable.
works_for: Older x86 laptops with working motherboard and LCD
Systems able to boot lightweight Linux from USB
not_for: Rooms with listeners sensitive to high-frequency noise
Long-term wall mounting of unprotected boards
en.value: Documents both working function and a real unresolved defect without hiding it.
en.follow: Test noise, temperature and reboot recovery as a complete laptop before framing it.
en.resource_label: Complete author build and fault log
en.resource_note: Covers MX Linux, Feh, VNC, mechanical steps and the unresolved 13.5 kHz whine.

zh.title: 旧笔记本键盘转 USB 控制器
zh.summary: 作者为 Acer/eMachines MP-09B23U4-6983 键盘反查矩阵，并用回收的 STM32 制作 USB 键盘控制器。
zh.gap: 笔记本键盘矩阵、FPC 和连接器高度不标准；目前是单一稀有型号的作者结果。
zh.next_check: 保存完整矩阵、固件、连接器规格和另一台主机的 USB 枚举测试。
zh.safety: 错误电压可能损坏键盘或控制器；先用限流电源和万用表查矩阵。
zh.usable: 对准确型号可成为 USB 键盘，方法也适合学习矩阵逆向。
works_for: Acer MP-09B23U4-6983 / PK130C93A00 作者型号
可逐键测量矩阵和焊接 FPC 的开发者
not_for: 任意笔记本键盘直接插 USB
带复杂背光、触控或专用控制芯片但无资料的模块
zh.value: 保留手感好的旧键盘，并展示型号级逆向过程。
zh.follow: 型号相同可深入；型号不同先把它当新的矩阵测绘项目。
zh.resource_label: 作者逆向与控制器日志
zh.resource_note: 记录具体键盘型号、矩阵、回收 STM32、USB 固件和连接器限制。

en.title: Convert an older laptop keyboard into USB
en.summary: The author reverse-maps an Acer/eMachines MP-09B23U4-6983 keyboard matrix and uses a salvaged STM32 as a USB keyboard controller.
en.gap: Laptop matrices, FPCs and connectors are highly nonstandard; this is an author result for one uncommon model.
en.next_check: Preserve the full matrix, firmware, connector specification and USB enumeration on another host.
en.safety: Incorrect voltage can damage the keyboard or controller; map it with current limiting and a meter first.
en.usable: The exact model can become a USB keyboard, and the method teaches matrix reverse engineering.
works_for: The author's Acer MP-09B23U4-6983 / PK130C93A00 model
Developers able to probe matrices and solder FPC connections
not_for: Plugging an arbitrary laptop keyboard directly into USB
Undocumented modules with complex backlight, touch or dedicated controllers
en.value: Preserves a good keyboard feel and demonstrates model-specific reverse engineering.
en.follow: Investigate further for the same model; treat every other model as a new matrix-mapping project.
en.resource_note: Records the exact keyboard, matrix, recycled STM32, USB firmware and connector limits.

zh.title: 旧 3D 打印机改 CNC 热封机
zh.summary: 教程利用仍能三轴运动并加热的 FDM 打印机，把喷嘴换成热封头，用于沿程序路径封合薄膜。
zh.gap: 材料、压力、温度窗口和成品密封强度需逐项测试；不同热端和固件没有统一参数。
zh.next_check: 用无食品用途的样片测试温度、速度、压力、重复性和恢复为打印机的步骤。
zh.safety: 热端、运动轴和熔融塑料会烫伤或起火；不能无人看护。
zh.usable: 作为可逆工装实验有明确步骤，适合闲置但运动系统正常的打印机。
works_for: 三轴和热端仍工作的 FFF/FDM 打印机
小批量薄膜封合实验
not_for: 食品、医疗或压力包装的合规密封
仍是主要生产工具且不愿停机的打印机
zh.value: 用现有运动控制和热端完成另一种可编程加工。
zh.follow: 先确保改装完全可回退并做破坏性样片测试；重要包装使用认证设备。
zh.resource_note: 包含测试旧机、拆喷嘴、改热封头和保持可逆性的提醒。

en.title: Convert an older 3D printer into a CNC heat sealer
en.summary: The instructions reuse an FFF/FDM printer with working three-axis motion and heater, replacing the nozzle with a sealing tool that follows programmed paths.
en.gap: Material, pressure, temperature window and seal strength need testing; there are no universal parameters across hot ends and firmware.
en.next_check: Use non-food samples to test temperature, speed, pressure, repeatability and restoration to printing.
en.safety: The hot end, moving axes and melted plastic can burn or ignite; never run unattended.
en.usable: A documented reversible tooling experiment for an idle printer with a functioning motion system.
works_for: FFF/FDM printers with working axes and heater
Small-batch film-sealing experiments
not_for: Regulated food, medical or pressure-package seals
A primary production printer that cannot be taken offline
en.value: Uses existing motion control and heat for a different programmable process.
en.follow: Keep the conversion reversible and destructively test samples first; use certified equipment for important packaging.
en.resource_note: Covers testing the old printer, removing the nozzle, fitting a sealer and preserving reversibility.

zh.title: Luggable PC：复用 Dell E1705 屏幕做便携台式机
zh.summary: 作者把显卡故障笔记本的 17 英寸 LCD 配专用控制板，与退役台式机零件组装成可搬运电脑，并完成 Mark I。
zh.gap: 控制板必须按精确面板编号匹配；作者后来转向新屏的 Mark II，旧版不再开发。
zh.next_check: 记录面板编号、控制板固件、背光类型、原生分辨率和电源规格。
zh.safety: CCFL 背光控制板有高压；裸面板、金属边和电源必须封装。
zh.usable: 同类 LCD 可通过匹配控制板成为标准视频显示器，并用于自制一体机。
works_for: Dell Inspiron E1705 的作者面板或有匹配控制板的 LCD
仍可用的退役 ATX/桌面部件
not_for: 只按尺寸购买控制板
希望轻薄和低功耗的便携电脑
zh.value: 包含面板控制板匹配和整机结构的实际经验。
zh.follow: 能读取精确面板型号并接受体积时继续；先台架点亮再做机箱。
zh.resource_label: Luggable PC 项目与屏幕日志
zh.resource_note: 记录 E1705 面板、控制板、分辨率问题、Mark I 完成和转向 Mark II。

en.title: Luggable PC: reuse a Dell E1705 panel in a portable desktop
en.summary: The author pairs a 17-inch LCD from a GPU-failed laptop with a model-specific controller and retired desktop parts to complete a luggable Mark I computer.
en.gap: The controller must match the exact panel number; the author later moved to a new-screen Mark II and stopped developing the salvaged version.
en.next_check: Record panel number, controller firmware, backlight type, native resolution and power specifications.
en.safety: CCFL backlight boards generate high voltage; enclose bare panels, sharp metal and power electronics.
en.usable: A matching LCD can become a standard-video display and part of a custom all-in-one computer.
works_for: The author's Dell Inspiron E1705 panel or LCDs with matched controllers
Still-functional retired ATX/desktop components
not_for: Buying controllers by screen size alone
Users seeking a thin, low-power portable computer
en.value: Includes real experience matching a controller to a panel and integrating a complete system.
en.follow: Continue if the exact panel number is known and size is acceptable; bench-test before building an enclosure.
en.resource_label: Luggable PC project and display log
en.resource_note: Documents the E1705 panel, controller, resolution issue, completed Mark I and move to Mark II.

zh.title: Window on the World：六台旧笔记本组成视频窗
zh.summary: 项目计划让六台相同旧笔记本通过 PXE 启动并把屏幕拼成窗格，用于城市间视频交流和艺术展示。
zh.gap: 搜索到的是具体方案日志，最终六机同步、摄像头链路、功耗和长期展览结果未完整核验。
zh.next_check: 确认完成照片/视频、PXE 镜像、同步方式、网络带宽和实际总功耗。
zh.safety: 多台老电源和电池不应封闭堆叠；先拆除鼓包电池并保证散热。
zh.usable: 可作为批量旧笔记本的网络启动拼屏实验，完成度仍需核实。
works_for: 尺寸和亮度接近的六台旧笔记本
能部署 PXE 和处理多节点视频的软件团队
not_for: 型号差异大且屏幕亮度不一致的随机设备
追求无边框或低功耗的正式显示墙
zh.value: 展示不拆面板也能通过网络协同复用整机的方法。
zh.follow: 手上有同批设备且用于艺术实验时继续；普通显示墙先核算能耗与维护。
zh.resource_label: 项目页与六机复用日志
zh.resource_note: 描述六台屏幕拼接、PXE、主从节点、摄像头和同型号设备要求。

en.title: Window on the World: combine six older laptops into a video window
en.summary: The project proposes PXE-booting six similar old laptops and arranging their screens as a window for inter-city video exchange and art display.
en.gap: The reviewed material is a detailed plan; final six-node synchronization, camera path, power and long-term exhibition results are not fully verified.
en.next_check: Find completion media, PXE image, synchronization method, network bandwidth and measured total power.
en.safety: Do not stack old adapters and batteries in a sealed frame; remove swollen cells and provide cooling.
en.usable: A network-boot tiled-screen experiment for a batch of old laptops, with final completion still uncertain.
works_for: Six older laptops with similar size and brightness
Teams able to deploy PXE and multi-node video software
not_for: Random models with mismatched panels
A low-power or bezel-free production video wall
en.value: Shows how whole machines can cooperate over the network without extracting their panels.
en.follow: Continue for an art experiment with a matching batch; calculate power and maintenance for regular signage.
en.resource_note: Describes six tiled screens, PXE, master/worker nodes, camera and matching-device requirements.

zh.title: Nokia N97 Cyberdeck：复用滑盖键盘和触摸外壳
zh.summary: 作者逆向 N97 键盘矩阵、FPC 和四线电阻触摸，计划用 Zero 形态 SBC、定制 PCB 与 3.2 英寸 HDMI 屏重建 Linux 掌机。

works_for: Nokia N97 外壳、键盘和触摸部件
能做细间距 PCB 与结构适配的开发者

无需焊接的普通用户改造
zh.value: 已公开键盘矩阵和连接器识别，降低同机型继续研究成本。

en.title: Nokia N97 Cyberdeck: reuse the slider keyboard and touch enclosure
en.summary: The author maps the N97 keyboard matrix, FPC and four-wire resistive touch, planning a Linux pocket computer with a Zero-form-factor SBC, custom PCB and 3.2-inch HDMI screen.
en.gap: Keyboard and touch are mapped, while the integrated PCB, power, screen fit and complete boot acceptance remain in progress.
en.next_check: Review the latest board, keyboard-scanning firmware, battery management, HDMI-screen assembly and bootable system.
en.safety: Fine-pitch FPC, an aged battery and tight slider space leave little tolerance; do not charge an unknown original cell.

works_for: Android 7–16 且能安装作者发布 APK 的闲置设备
Home Assistant 局域网内的面板与 BLE 覆盖实验
not_for: 无法安全长期供电的老化电池设备
要求已证明多年稳定的关键家庭控制
zh.value: 把显示、语音和 BLE 三种旧手机价值合在一条路线。
zh.follow: 用备用设备短期试运行并观察权限/耗电；关键控制保留替代入口。
zh.resource_label: 作者社区发布与反馈帖
zh.resource_note: 说明 Android 范围、32 位、Home Assistant 自动发现、BLE Proxy 和早期用户反馈。

en.title: Ava: turn older Android phones/tablets into HA panels and BLE gateways
en.summary: The author releases an Ava variant for Android 7–16 including 32-bit devices, turning spares into Home Assistant voice/control panels with a BLE Proxy gateway.
en.gap: This is a 2026 community beta; long-running background behavior, microphone variation, BLE stability, privacy and updates lack broad reproduction.
en.next_check: Test discovery, control, BLE, reboot recovery, permissions and power on one Android 7 and one newer device.
en.safety: Check battery health and charge limits before continuous power, and sideload only from the author's release link.
en.usable: A trial path for spare devices that can still install the APK; low-end support is an author claim.
works_for: Spare Android 7–16 devices able to install the author release
Panel and BLE-coverage experiments on a Home Assistant LAN
not_for: Aged batteries that cannot be powered safely
Critical home control requiring proven multi-year stability
en.value: Combines display, voice and BLE roles into one old-phone route.
en.follow: Pilot on a spare device and observe permissions/power; retain another control path for critical functions.
en.resource_label: Author community release and feedback thread
en.resource_note: States Android range, 32-bit support, Home Assistant discovery, BLE Proxy and early feedback.

zh.title: 坏笔记本 LCD 背光改便携描图灯板
zh.summary: 教程移除破损液晶层，保留扩散片和 CCFL/LED 背光，把不能显示图像的屏幕组件变成绘图灯板。
zh.gap: 不同背光电压和驱动板差异大；亮度均匀性、绝缘和长期温升未统一测试。
zh.next_check: 确认 LED 或 CCFL 类型、原驱动输入、电源规格、绝缘和 2 小时温升。
zh.safety: CCFL 逆变器会产生高压，破裂 LCD 和金属边缘也可能割伤。
zh.usable: 当 LCD 破裂但背光完好时，可恢复为透光绘图工具。
works_for: 背光和扩散层完整的坏笔记本屏幕
能保留或安全替换原背光驱动的模块
not_for: 背光也损坏或扩散膜污染严重
不熟悉 CCFL 高压的人拆老屏
zh.value: 不需要匹配视频控制板，能利用显示失败但照明仍好的部件。
zh.follow: LED 背光低压方案更适合继续；CCFL 模块先评估高压风险。
zh.resource_note: 展示拆除 LCD、保留背光和扩散层、重装便携灯板的全过程。

en.title: Turn a broken laptop LCD backlight into a portable light table
en.summary: The tutorial removes the broken liquid-crystal layer while retaining diffuser sheets and CCFL/LED backlight, turning a non-imaging screen assembly into a drawing light table.
en.gap: Backlight voltage and driver boards vary; uniformity, insulation and long-term temperature are not standardized.
en.next_check: Identify LED or CCFL type, driver input, power specification, insulation and two-hour temperature rise.
en.safety: CCFL inverters generate high voltage, while broken LCD glass and metal edges can cut.
en.usable: A panel with failed LCD but working backlight can become a tracing/drawing tool.
works_for: Broken laptop screens with intact backlight and diffuser layers
Modules whose original backlight driver can be retained or safely replaced
not_for: Failed backlights or badly contaminated optical films
Opening CCFL panels without high-voltage experience
en.value: Avoids a video controller and uses the illumination portion when image production is no longer possible.
en.follow: Low-voltage LED backlights are better candidates; assess CCFL high-voltage risk first.
en.resource_note: Shows LCD removal, preserved backlight/diffusers and reassembly as a portable light table.

zh.title: 旧笔记本 LCD 加控制板变外接显示器
zh.summary: 作者按面板型号购买对应控制板和电源，把拆下的笔记本 LCD 改成独立外接显示器。
zh.gap: 旧教程依赖第三方卖家匹配；LVDS/eDP、背光、电源和固件必须按准确面板核对。
zh.next_check: 读取面板背标完整编号，让控制板供应商书面确认分辨率、接口和背光，再台架测试。
zh.safety: 不要只按尺寸购买或带电插拔排线；CCFL 版本含高压逆变器。
zh.usable: 型号匹配时能成为 HDMI/DVI/VGA 等输入的显示器。
works_for: 面板本身正常且能找到精确匹配控制板的 LCD
愿意制作安全外壳和固定支架的用户
not_for: 破裂 LCD 或无法读取面板编号
把 30/40 针和 LVDS/eDP 当作可互换
zh.value: 是最直接、最普遍的笔记本部件复用之一。
zh.follow: 先确认面板编号和控制板固件；匹配不确定就不要下单。
zh.resource_note: 说明拆屏、按型号匹配控制板、电源、视频输入和外壳选择。

en.title: Add a controller board to use a laptop LCD as an external monitor
en.summary: The author buys a controller and power supply matched to the panel number, turning a removed laptop LCD into a standalone external display.
en.gap: The older tutorial depends on third-party seller matching; LVDS/eDP, backlight, power and firmware must match the exact panel.
en.next_check: Read the complete panel label and obtain written confirmation of resolution, interface and backlight before bench testing.
en.safety: Do not buy by size or hot-plug panel cables; CCFL versions contain a high-voltage inverter.
en.usable: With a correct match, the panel can accept HDMI/DVI/VGA or similar standard inputs.
works_for: Working LCDs with an exact compatible controller
Users able to build a safe enclosure and mount
not_for: Cracked LCDs or panels without readable identifiers
Treating 30/40-pin and LVDS/eDP as interchangeable
en.value: One of the most direct and broadly useful laptop-part reuse routes.
en.follow: Confirm panel number and controller firmware first; do not order when matching is uncertain.
en.resource_note: Covers panel removal, model-specific controller, power, video input and enclosure choices.

zh.title: 整台旧笔记本重装成复古外观媒体 PC
zh.summary: 30 步教程复用笔记本主板、IPS 屏、Wi-Fi 天线、摄像头和扬声器，重新制作木质机身与遥控媒体电脑。
zh.gap: 作者涉及拆电池包并测试 18650；该部分不适合普通用户复制，软件版本也可能过时。
zh.next_check: 优先做插电版本，核对主板散热、屏线、扬声器功放、自动启动和遥控。
zh.safety: 不要自行拆解和重组未知状态的笔记本电池包；裸主板与电源要可靠固定。
zh.usable: 主板和屏幕仍工作时，可高度复用整机部件做固定媒体终端。
works_for: 屏幕、主板和扬声器尚可工作的旧笔记本
能制作机箱和重新布置散热的制作者
not_for: 主板或屏幕已损坏的机器
没有锂电安全经验却照搬电池步骤
zh.value: 比只拆屏更充分地复用原机部件，并给出完整机械过程。
zh.follow: 先做无电池插电版本；功能和温度稳定后再完善外壳。
zh.resource_note: 覆盖拆机、屏幕、天线、摄像头、扬声器、木工、遥控和电池风险步骤。

en.title: Rehouse an entire older laptop as a vintage-style media PC
en.summary: A thirty-step build reuses a laptop motherboard, IPS display, Wi-Fi antennas, camera and speakers in a new wooden enclosure with media controls.
en.gap: The author opens a battery pack and evaluates 18650 cells; that step is not suitable for general copying, and software versions may be old.
en.next_check: Build an adapter-powered version first, verifying cooling, display cable, speaker amplifier, autostart and remote control.
en.safety: Do not open and rebuild unknown laptop battery packs without lithium expertise; secure bare boards and power components.
en.usable: When the board and screen work, many original parts can become a fixed media terminal.
works_for: Older laptops with working display, board and speakers
Builders able to fabricate an enclosure and redesign cooling
not_for: Machines with failed motherboard or panel
Copying battery-pack work without lithium safety experience
en.value: Reuses more of the original machine than a panel-only conversion and documents the full mechanical process.
en.follow: Start adapter-powered without the battery; finish the enclosure after function and temperature remain stable.
en.resource_note: Covers teardown, display, antennas, camera, speakers, woodworking, remote and risky battery work.

zh.title: 旧笔记本屏幕做壁挂在线日历
zh.summary: 作者用回收的笔记本 LCD、匹配控制板和树莓派制作壁挂 Google Calendar，手机更新后墙面自动显示。
zh.gap: 教程依赖旧浏览器和 Google 页面行为；账号登录、Kiosk、断网和自动恢复需要按当前环境重做。
zh.next_check: 核对面板控制板、只读日历账号、Kiosk 自启动、断网提示和重启恢复。
zh.safety: 墙内走线和裸控制板要符合低压供电、散热和防火要求。
zh.usable: 可成为家庭日程显示屏，但依赖云账号和网络。
works_for: 有匹配视频控制板的旧笔记本 LCD
能运行当前浏览器的树莓派或小主机
not_for: 要求完全离线的家庭日历
把个人主账号永久登录在不受保护的显示器
zh.value: 提供一个清晰、日常可见的旧屏幕用途。
zh.follow: 使用独立只读账号和自动恢复后值得试；隐私要求高时用本地日历。
zh.resource_note: 说明回收屏、控制板、树莓派、浏览器和木质壁挂结构。

en.title: Build a wall calendar from a recycled laptop display
en.summary: The author uses a salvaged laptop LCD, matching controller and Raspberry Pi for a wall-mounted Google Calendar that follows phone updates.
en.gap: The tutorial depends on old browser and Google behavior; authentication, kiosk mode, offline handling and recovery need current redesign.
en.next_check: Verify the panel controller, a read-only calendar account, kiosk autostart, offline status and reboot recovery.
en.safety: In-wall wiring and bare controllers require low-voltage power, ventilation and fire-conscious mounting.
en.usable: A practical household schedule display that depends on a cloud account and network.
works_for: Laptop LCDs with matched video controllers
Raspberry Pi or small hosts capable of a current browser
not_for: A fully offline household calendar
Leaving a personal primary account logged into an exposed display
en.value: Provides a clear everyday role for an otherwise unused screen.
en.follow: Worth trying with a separate read-only account and recovery; use local calendars when privacy is critical.
en.resource_note: Describes the salvaged display, controller, Raspberry Pi, browser and wooden wall enclosure.

zh.title: 旧 3D 打印机改轻型 CNC
zh.summary: 作者测试闲置打印机三轴后，拆除挤出系统、增加独立主轴和刀具，把运动平台改作轻型切削。
zh.gap: 3D 打印机框架刚度、轴承和防尘通常不适合重切削；精度、材料和急停方案需逐机验证。
zh.next_check: 从软材料浅切开始，测刚度、跳动、粉尘、限位、急停和电气噪声。
zh.safety: 旋转刀具会甩出碎片；需要护目、夹具、防护罩、吸尘和可达急停。
zh.usable: 可做泡沫、蜡、软木等轻加工实验，不应假定能铣金属。
works_for: 机械结构仍可靠的闲置笛卡尔打印机
低负载软材料雕刻与学习
not_for: 金属重切削或无人值守
结构松动、线路暴露且无急停的机器
zh.value: 复用三轴运动系统，但也明确展示机械用途改变后的限制。
zh.follow: 有机加工防护并接受轻切削时继续；普通打印机能修好时先修复。
zh.resource_label: 八步 CNC 改造教程
zh.resource_note: 记录旧机测试、机械重构、独立主轴和初步加工路线。

en.title: Convert an older 3D printer into a light-duty CNC machine
en.summary: The author tests the idle printer's three axes, removes extrusion hardware and adds a separately powered spindle and tool for light cutting.
en.gap: Printer frames, bearings and dust protection are usually unsuitable for heavy machining; accuracy, materials and emergency stop need device-specific tests.
en.next_check: Begin with shallow cuts in soft stock and measure rigidity, runout, dust, limits, emergency stop and electrical noise.
en.safety: Rotating tools can eject debris; use eye protection, clamps, guarding, extraction and an accessible emergency stop.
en.usable: A learning route for foam, wax, soft wood and other light work, not assumed metal milling.
works_for: Idle Cartesian printers with reliable mechanics
Low-load engraving and learning on soft materials
not_for: Heavy metal cutting or unattended operation
Loose mechanisms or exposed wiring without emergency stop
en.value: Reuses the three-axis platform while exposing the limits caused by changing the machine's process.
en.follow: Continue with machining safeguards and light-cut expectations; repair a still-useful printer first.
en.resource_note: Documents old-machine testing, mechanical changes, separate spindle and initial machining route.

zh.title: 旧笔记本外接电视做媒体中心
zh.summary: 旧教程让一台 1GB 内存 Acer 笔记本通过 OpenELEC/XBMC 从 U 盘启动并连接电视，说明低规格设备曾可承担 HTPC。
zh.gap: OpenELEC/XBMC 版本和安装链接已过时；流媒体 DRM、浏览器、解码和安全更新不能照搬。
zh.next_check: 保留硬件思路，改用当前受支持系统，并按 CPU/GPU 检查硬解码、HDMI 音频和遥控。
zh.safety: 老电池鼓包时移除；不要让积尘散热口在电视柜内长期高温运行。
zh.usable: 作为历史方法可帮助判断旧笔记本是否适合离线本地媒体。
works_for: 能稳定启动、带可用视频输出的旧 x86 笔记本
主要播放本地低码率媒体的场景
not_for: 直接安装教程中的旧镜像联网使用
期待所有现代流媒体和 4K 解码
zh.value: 保存最简单的整机复用路线，同时提醒软件时代已经变化。
zh.follow: 先用当前系统做硬解码与安全更新测试；不合格则转成离线播放或其他用途。
zh.resource_note: 记录旧 Acer、1GB 内存、U 盘安装和电视媒体中心目标；软件已过时。

en.title: Connect an older laptop to a TV as a media center
en.summary: A historical guide boots OpenELEC/XBMC from USB on a 1 GB Acer laptop connected to a television, showing that low-spec hardware once served as an HTPC.
en.gap: OpenELEC/XBMC versions and links are obsolete; modern DRM, browsers, decoding and security updates cannot be copied directly.
en.next_check: Retain the hardware idea but use a supported current system, checking CPU/GPU decode, HDMI audio and remote control.
en.safety: Remove swollen batteries and do not leave dust-blocked cooling in a hot TV cabinet.
en.usable: Useful as a historical pattern for deciding whether an old laptop can play local offline media.
works_for: Stable older x86 laptops with usable video output
Mostly local lower-bitrate media playback
not_for: Installing the guide's old image on a network today
Expecting all modern streaming services and 4K decode
en.value: Preserves the simplest whole-machine reuse route while making the outdated software boundary visible.
en.follow: Test current software, hardware decode and updates first; fall back to offline playback or another role.
en.resource_note: Records an old Acer, 1 GB RAM, USB installation and TV-media-center goal; software is obsolete.

zh.title: 旧 Samsung S5 改宠物视频监控
zh.summary: 作者把旧 Samsung S5 作为摄像端，通过当时的第三方应用和账号在另一台手机查看宠物画面。
zh.gap: 教程依赖的 Eyecura 服务和商店可用性需重新核验；隐私、加密、后台保活和电池长期供电未测试。
zh.next_check: 确认应用当前存在、数据去向、局域网/云模式、权限、重启恢复和充电限制。
zh.safety: 摄像头要尊重隐私并避免拍摄他人；老电池长期充电前检查膨胀和温度。
zh.usable: 旧手机相机和 Wi-Fi 足够时可做临时宠物监控，具体应用路线可能过时。
works_for: 摄像头、Wi-Fi 和应用商店仍工作的闲置手机
短期、非关键的室内观察
not_for: 安全关键监控或秘密录制
电池异常、系统无法更新的长期无人值守设备
zh.value: 展示零额外相机硬件的快速验证方式，也暴露云服务依赖。
zh.follow: 先用本地、可审计应用短期测试；关键监控使用受维护设备。
zh.resource_note: 说明 Samsung S5、第三方应用、账号、远程查看和简易支架。

en.title: Reuse an old Samsung S5 as a pet video monitor
en.summary: The author uses an old Samsung S5 as the camera endpoint and views a pet from another phone through a third-party app and account available at the time.
en.gap: The Eyecura service and store availability need fresh verification; privacy, encryption, background reliability and continuous charging are untested.
en.next_check: Confirm current app availability, data path, LAN/cloud mode, permissions, reboot recovery and charge limits.
en.safety: Respect privacy and avoid recording others without consent; inspect aged batteries for swelling and heat before continuous charging.
en.usable: A spare phone with working camera and Wi-Fi can provide temporary pet monitoring, though the specific app route may be obsolete.
works_for: Spare phones with functioning camera, Wi-Fi and app installation
Short-term noncritical indoor observation
not_for: Security-critical surveillance or covert recording
Unattended long-term use of unsafe batteries or unpatched systems
en.value: Demonstrates a no-extra-camera pilot while exposing dependence on a cloud service.
en.follow: Pilot briefly with a local auditable app; use maintained devices for critical monitoring.
en.resource_note: Describes the Samsung S5, third-party app/account, remote viewing and simple mount.

zh.title: 废旧路由器外壳和 LED 改 Arduino 项目盒
zh.summary: 作者复用故障 Thomson TG585 路由器外壳、开关、LED 和电源接口，装入自制家居自动化原型。
zh.gap: 主要复用机械与简单元件，不是复活路由器主板；不同外壳的 PCB、绝缘和固定方式需重新设计。
zh.next_check: 确认原电源接口极性、LED 限流、板卡固定、开孔和长期电池/供电方案。
zh.safety: 必须完全移除或隔离未知原电源电路，避免松动板卡短路。
zh.usable: 可快速得到带指示灯、按钮和易开盖的低压项目外壳。
works_for: 故障但外壳完整的低压路由器
Arduino、传感器或门铃接口等低压原型
not_for: 希望继续使用原路由器网络功能
把未知原电源板直接接入新项目
zh.value: 低难度复用外壳和人机接口，适合大量常见电子废件。
zh.follow: 确认低压与绝缘后值得做；原路由器还能修复时优先修复整机。
zh.resource_note: 展示 TG585 外壳、LED、开关、电源口和可拆原型板安装。

en.title: Reuse a failed router enclosure and LEDs for an Arduino project
en.summary: The author reuses a failed Thomson TG585 router case, switch, LEDs and power connector to house a home-automation prototype.
en.gap: This reuses the mechanics and simple parts rather than reviving the router board; PCB isolation and mounting vary by enclosure.
en.next_check: Verify connector polarity, LED current limiting, board retention, openings and long-term power/battery design.
en.safety: Fully remove or isolate unknown original power circuits and prevent loose boards from shorting.
en.usable: Provides a low-voltage enclosure with indicators, button and easy access.
works_for: Failed low-voltage routers with intact cases
Arduino, sensor or doorbell-interface prototypes
not_for: Retaining original router networking function
Connecting an unknown original power board directly to the new project
en.value: A low-complexity way to reuse common enclosures and interfaces from electronic waste.
en.follow: Worth doing after low-voltage and insulation checks; repair the whole router first if it remains viable.
en.resource_note: Shows the TG585 case, LEDs, switch, power jack and removable prototype-board mounting.
